name: fmcad
description: Standalone API, CLI, MCP server, and optional OpenCode plugin for Autodesk Fusion.

scripts.build: npm run build:code && node dist/scripts/adsk-refresh/cli.js --pinned scripts/adsk-refresh/api-lock.json dist/runtime/python/typing && node dist/scripts/devtools/stage-core.js --identity-only
